## Purpose and interpretation

This workflow tests the complete path from a RefmatDB metadata search to a
checksum-verified reference download, clustifyr scoring, and annotations saved
on a Seurat object. All query expression data remain local. The original
`so.rds` is read only; the annotated object is written to `outputs/`.

**This is an integration test, not an independent annotation benchmark.** The
available reference is mouse mammary tissue, and the supplied object has mouse
gene symbols and mammary cell labels. Its provenance may overlap the reference
dataset. Agreement with the existing annotations therefore does not establish
accuracy on unseen data. Correlation scores are not probabilities, and the
0.3 cutoff is an illustrative, configurable threshold, not a calibrated one.

## Environment

Run `Rscript setup.R` once, then `quarto render workflow.qmd` from this folder.
Subsequent setups restore `renv.lock`. Dependencies are installed by setup,
never implicitly while rendering. The full session information is included at
the end and saved with the results.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(refmatR)
library(Seurat)
library(clustifyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(digest)
library(knitr)
set.seed(42)
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
stopifnot(file.exists(params$input_file))
input_hash <- digest::digest(file = params$input_file, algo = "sha256")
package_versions <- data.frame(
  package = c("refmatR", "Seurat", "SeuratObject", "clustifyr", "renv"),
  version = vapply(c("refmatR", "Seurat", "SeuratObject", "clustifyr", "renv"),
                   function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), character(1))
)
kable(package_versions)
```

## Search RefmatDB and select a reference

The reference UUID is explicitly pinned in the parameters. Searching by species
and tissue verifies that it is still an appropriate catalog candidate; the
workflow does not silently choose the first result if that reference disappears.
Public access is used for this run. For a private reference, change the client
to `refmatdb(params$server)` and set `REFMATDB_TOKEN` privately in your environment.

```{r}
#| label: search
client <- refmatdb(params$server, token = "")
hits <- refmat_search(client, species = params$species, tissue = params$tissue,
                      all = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(hits) > 0, params$reference_id %in% hits$id)
kable(hits[, c("id", "name", "species", "tissue", "n_genes", "n_celltypes")])
info <- refmat_info(params$reference_id, client)
stopifnot(info$species == params$species, info$gene_id_type == "symbol")
kable(data.frame(field = c("source", "value_type", "sha256"),
                 value = c(info$source, info$value_type, info$sha256)))
celltypes <- refmat_celltypes(client, species = params$species,
                              tissue = params$tissue, all = TRUE)
kable(celltypes)
```

## Download and inspect the reference

The original file is saved with SHA-256 validation. Parsing handles CSV, TSV,
and gzip by content and returns genes in rows and cell types in columns.
No reference expression transformation or identifier conversion is performed.
The file extension here is only a local name; the original filename is recorded
in `reference-metadata.json`.

```{r}
#| label: reference
reference_path <- file.path("data", paste0(params$reference_id, ".refmat"))
refmat_download(params$reference_id, reference_path, client, overwrite = TRUE)
reference <- refmat_read(reference_path)
stopifnot(is.numeric(reference), all(is.finite(reference)),
          nrow(reference) == info$n_genes, ncol(reference) == info$n_celltypes)
jsonlite::write_json(info, "outputs/reference-metadata.json", pretty = TRUE,
                     auto_unbox = TRUE, null = "null")
kable(data.frame(cell_type = colnames(reference)))
```

## Load and prepare the Seurat object

The existing clusters are retained. RNA counts are normalized explicitly with
Seurat's LogNormalize method (scale factor 10,000), giving natural-log1p input
for `if_log = TRUE` in clustifyr. The workflow does not use scaled residuals or
integrated expression. Existing UMAP coordinates and original annotations are
preserved. No cells are subsampled.

```{r}
#| label: query
so <- readRDS(params$input_file)
stopifnot(inherits(so, "Seurat"), params$assay %in% Assays(so))
DefaultAssay(so) <- params$assay
if (inherits(so[[params$assay]], "Assay5") &&
    any(grepl("^counts\\.", Layers(so[[params$assay]])))) {
  so <- JoinLayers(so, assay = params$assay)
}
stopifnot("counts" %in% Layers(so[[params$assay]]))
metadata <- so[[]]
stopifnot(params$cluster_col %in% names(metadata),
          !anyNA(metadata[[params$cluster_col]]),
          !anyDuplicated(colnames(so)), !anyDuplicated(rownames(so)))
metadata <- metadata[colnames(so), , drop = FALSE]
so <- NormalizeData(so, assay = params$assay, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                    scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
so <- FindVariableFeatures(so, assay = params$assay, selection.method = "vst",
                           nfeatures = params$n_variable_genes, verbose = FALSE)
query <- LayerData(so, assay = params$assay, layer = "data")
shared <- intersect(rownames(query), rownames(reference))
query_genes <- intersect(VariableFeatures(so), shared)
stopifnot(length(query_genes) >= params$min_shared_genes)
# Only the selected genes are passed to clustifyr to bound memory use.
query <- query[query_genes, colnames(so), drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(query), rownames(metadata)))
summary_table <- data.frame(
  metric = c("Cells", "Clusters", "Query genes", "Reference genes",
             "Shared genes", "Shared variable genes used"),
  value = c(ncol(so), length(unique(metadata[[params$cluster_col]])), nrow(so),
            nrow(reference), length(shared), length(query_genes))
)
kable(summary_table)
write.csv(summary_table, "outputs/input-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(query_genes, "outputs/query-genes.txt")
```

## Score clusters and assign candidate labels

Spearman correlations compare cluster expression profiles with each reference
cell type. The best-minus-second-best score is reported as an ambiguity
indicator, not as a statistical confidence interval. Low-scoring clusters
remain unassigned using the configured cutoff.

```{r}
#| label: annotate
scores <- clustifyr::clustify(
  input = query, ref_mat = reference, metadata = metadata,
  cluster_col = params$cluster_col, query_genes = query_genes,
  if_log = TRUE, compute_method = "spearman", verbose = FALSE
)
stopifnot(is.matrix(scores), all(is.finite(scores)),
          nrow(scores) == length(unique(metadata[[params$cluster_col]])),
          setequal(colnames(scores), colnames(reference)))
calls <- as.data.frame(clustifyr::cor_to_call(
  scores, threshold = params$correlation_threshold))
calls$cluster <- as.character(calls$cluster)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(calls$cluster))
ranked <- t(apply(scores, 1, sort, decreasing = TRUE))
margins <- ranked[, 1] - ranked[, 2]
calls$margin <- unname(margins[calls$cluster])
calls$n_cells <- as.integer(table(as.character(metadata[[params$cluster_col]]))[calls$cluster])
index <- match(as.character(metadata[[params$cluster_col]]), calls$cluster)
stopifnot(!anyNA(index))
so$refmatR_type <- as.character(calls$type[index])
so$refmatR_score <- as.numeric(calls$r[index])
so$refmatR_margin <- calls$margin[index]
so$refmatR_reference_id <- params$reference_id
so$refmatR_reference_sha256 <- info$sha256
write.csv(scores, "outputs/cluster-correlations.csv")
write.csv(calls, "outputs/cluster-calls.csv", row.names = FALSE)
kable(calls, digits = 3)
```

### Correlation heatmap

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
long <- as.data.frame(as.table(scores), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(long) <- c("cluster", "reference_type", "correlation")
ggplot(long, aes(reference_type, cluster, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() + scale_fill_viridis_c() + theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Reference cell type", y = "Query cluster", fill = "Spearman r")
```

## Compare original and clustifyr annotations

Both UMAP panels use exactly the same cells, coordinates, axes, and color map.
Labels are compared literally; no synonyms or related cell types are silently
merged. These are agreement diagnostics, not accuracy estimates against an
independent ground truth.

```{r}
#| label: comparison-data
stopifnot(params$existing_label_col %in% colnames(metadata),
          params$review_score_threshold >= -1, params$review_score_threshold <= 1,
          params$review_margin_threshold >= 0)
original <- as.character(metadata[[params$existing_label_col]])
predicted <- as.character(so$refmatR_type)
known_original <- !is.na(original) & nzchar(trimws(original))
original[!known_original] <- "[Missing original label]"
predicted[is.na(predicted) | !nzchar(trimws(predicted))] <- "[Unassigned]"
label_levels <- sort(unique(c(original, predicted)))
palette <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(label_levels), "Dark 3"), label_levels)
if ("[Missing original label]" %in% label_levels) palette["[Missing original label]"] <- "grey65"
if ("[Unassigned]" %in% label_levels) palette["[Unassigned]"] <- "grey35"
```

### Side-by-side UMAPs

```{r}
#| label: umap-comparison
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8
if ("umap" %in% Reductions(so)) {
  embedding <- Embeddings(so, reduction = "umap")[rownames(metadata), 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(embedding), rownames(metadata)))
  plot_data <- rbind(
    data.frame(UMAP_1 = embedding[, 1], UMAP_2 = embedding[, 2],
               label = original, annotation = "Original celltypes"),
    data.frame(UMAP_1 = embedding[, 1], UMAP_2 = embedding[, 2],
               label = predicted, annotation = "clustifyr candidates"))
  plot_data$annotation <- factor(plot_data$annotation,
                                levels = c("Original celltypes", "clustifyr candidates"))
  plot_data$label <- factor(plot_data$label, levels = label_levels)
  umap_comparison <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = label)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.8) + coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~annotation, nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, drop = FALSE) + theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(color = "Cell type", title = "Original and clustifyr annotations on the same UMAP")
  print(umap_comparison)
  ggsave("outputs/umap-comparison.png", umap_comparison, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 180)
} else {
  cat("No existing UMAP is present; no new embedding was calculated.")
}
```

### Confusion matrix: original versus predicted labels

Rows are original labels; columns are clustifyr labels. Tile color shows the
percentage within each original-label row, and the text gives the cell count.
Missing original labels remain visible but are excluded from agreement rates.

```{r}
#| label: confusion-matrix
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10
agreement <- table(original = factor(original, levels = label_levels),
                   predicted = factor(predicted, levels = label_levels))
stopifnot(sum(agreement) == ncol(so))
row_percent <- sweep(agreement, 1, pmax(rowSums(agreement), 1), "/") * 100
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(agreement), "outputs/existing-label-comparison.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(agreement), "outputs/confusion-counts.csv")
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(row_percent), "outputs/confusion-row-percent.csv")
confusion_data <- as.data.frame(agreement)
confusion_data$row_percent <- as.vector(row_percent)
confusion_data$original <- factor(confusion_data$original, levels = rev(label_levels))
confusion_plot <- ggplot(confusion_data, aes(predicted, original, fill = row_percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Freq > 0, Freq, ""),
                color = row_percent > 50), size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#173b4b", "TRUE" = "white")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f2f7fa", high = "#164d70", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  coord_equal() + theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "clustifyr label", y = "Original label", fill = "% within\noriginal label",
       title = "Label agreement by cell", subtitle = "Numbers are cell counts; color is row percentage")
print(confusion_plot)
ggsave("outputs/confusion-matrix.png", confusion_plot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 180)
```

### Clusters to review

A cluster is flagged if **any cell with an existing label disagrees** with its
clustifyr call, if its top correlation is below
`r params$review_score_threshold`, or if its top-minus-runner-up margin is below
`r params$review_margin_threshold`. Missing original labels and tied original
majorities are also flagged. The review score threshold is separate from the
`r params$correlation_threshold` cutoff used to assign calls. These configurable
heuristics identify candidates for inspection; they are not calibrated confidence
probabilities. Mixed original labels can produce disagreement even when the
majority label matches.

```{r}
#| label: cluster-review
cluster_ids <- as.character(metadata[[params$cluster_col]])
cluster_review <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(calls)), function(i) {
  cluster <- calls$cluster[i]
  members <- which(cluster_ids == cluster)
  known <- members[known_original[members]]
  tally <- sort(table(original[known]), decreasing = TRUE)
  majorities <- if (length(tally)) names(tally)[tally == max(tally)] else character()
  score_order <- order(scores[cluster, ], decreasing = TRUE)
  top_score <- scores[cluster, score_order[1]]
  runner_up <- colnames(scores)[score_order[2]]
  runner_score <- scores[cluster, score_order[2]]
  n_disagree <- sum(original[known] != predicted[known])
  low_score <- top_score < params$review_score_threshold
  small_margin <- top_score - runner_score < params$review_margin_threshold
  flags <- c(if (n_disagree > 0) "Label disagreement",
             if (low_score) "Low correlation",
             if (small_margin) "Small margin",
             if (length(known) < length(members)) "Missing original labels",
             if (length(majorities) > 1) "Tied original majority")
  data.frame(cluster = cluster, n_cells = length(members), n_known_original = length(known),
    original_majority = if (length(majorities)) paste(majorities, collapse = " / ") else NA_character_,
    majority_pct = if (length(tally)) 100 * max(tally) / length(known) else NA_real_,
    predicted = predicted[members[1]],
    agreement_pct = if (length(known)) 100 * (length(known) - n_disagree) / length(known) else NA_real_,
    n_disagree = n_disagree, top_score = unname(top_score), runner_up = runner_up,
    runner_up_score = unname(runner_score), margin = unname(top_score - runner_score),
    low_score = low_score, small_margin = small_margin, flagged = length(flags) > 0,
    reasons = if (length(flags)) paste(flags, collapse = "; ") else "No flags")
}))
cluster_review <- cluster_review[order(!cluster_review$flagged,
  -cluster_review$n_disagree, cluster_review$margin), ]
stopifnot(sum(cluster_review$n_cells) == ncol(so),
          sum(cluster_review$n_disagree) == sum(original[known_original] != predicted[known_original]),
          all(abs(cluster_review$margin - margins[cluster_review$cluster]) < 1e-10))
write.csv(cluster_review, "outputs/cluster-review.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cluster_review[cluster_review$flagged, ], "outputs/flagged-clusters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
review_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("Clusters reviewed", "Flagged clusters", "Clusters with label disagreement",
             "Low-correlation clusters", "Small-margin clusters", "Cells with known original labels",
             "Cells agreeing with original label", "Cells disagreeing with original label"),
  value = c(nrow(cluster_review), sum(cluster_review$flagged), sum(cluster_review$n_disagree > 0),
            sum(cluster_review$low_score), sum(cluster_review$small_margin), sum(known_original),
            sum(original[known_original] == predicted[known_original]), sum(cluster_review$n_disagree)))
kable(review_summary)
write.csv(review_summary, "outputs/review-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Flagged rows are shaded and list the reason for review. Agreement and majority
percentages use only cells with a known original label. The full-precision CSV
also includes runner-up scores, missing-label denominators, and individual flags.

```{r}
#| label: review-table
#| results: asis
view <- data.frame(
  Cluster = cluster_review$cluster, Cells = cluster_review$n_cells,
  `Original majority (%)` = paste0(cluster_review$original_majority, " (",
                                    round(cluster_review$majority_pct, 1), ")"),
  Predicted = cluster_review$predicted,
  `Agreement (%)` = round(cluster_review$agreement_pct, 1),
  `Best r` = round(cluster_review$top_score, 3),
  `Runner-up` = cluster_review$runner_up, Margin = round(cluster_review$margin, 3),
  Review = cluster_review$reasons, check.names = FALSE)
escape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", as.character(x), fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
cat('<div style="overflow-x:auto"><table class="table table-sm"><caption>Cluster review, flagged rows first</caption><thead><tr>')
cat(paste0('<th scope="col">', escape(names(view)), '</th>', collapse = ''))
cat('</tr></thead><tbody>')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(view))) {
  cat(if (cluster_review$flagged[i]) '<tr style="background-color:#fff2d9">' else '<tr>')
  cat(paste0('<td>', escape(unlist(view[i, ], use.names = FALSE)), '</td>', collapse = ''))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table></div>')
```

## Save results and verify the input was preserved

```{r}
#| label: save
manifest <- list(
  executed_at = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
  input_file = params$input_file, input_sha256 = input_hash,
  reference_id = info$id, reference_sha256 = info$sha256,
  server = params$server, parameters = params,
  n_cells = ncol(so), n_clusters = nrow(scores), n_query_genes = length(query_genes),
  packages = package_versions,
  caveat = "Integration test; reference/query independence not established."
)
so@misc$refmatR <- manifest
saveRDS(so, "outputs/so_refmatR_annotated.rds")
jsonlite::write_json(manifest, "outputs/run-manifest.json", pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
stopifnot(identical(input_hash, digest::digest(file = params$input_file, algo = "sha256")))
restored <- readRDS("outputs/so_refmatR_annotated.rds")
stopifnot(identical(colnames(restored), colnames(so)),
          identical(restored$refmatR_type, so$refmatR_type))
cat("PASS: search, verified download, matrix import, cluster scoring, annotation, and saved-object reload.\n")
cat("Original input SHA-256 is unchanged.\n")
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), "outputs/session-info.txt")
```
